description: Checks the game again and, when it is ok, saves the script on vxlverse.com under a short link (https://vxlverse.com/make/<id>) that opens it, ready to play, in the 3D editor; anyone with the link can open it. Use it once the game passes check_game. The same script always gets the same link, so a retry creates nothing new and nothing is ever overwritten.

lang.description: The user's language for the site around the game. Default en.

script.description: The whole game as plain VXLScript, in English, starting with its Title: line.

name: create_game_link
title: Create the game link
